questions.question: Select the correct option that will fill in the blank and complete the series. J, N, R, V, ______
questions.solution:
Given series: J, N, R, V, ______

Pattern: Each letter has been succeeded by four letters.

J **+ 4 **= N

N **+ 4** = R

R **+ 4 **= V

V **+ 4 **= **Z**

Hence, **Z **is correct.

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion logically and definitely follow (s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements**:

All houses are rivers.

All rivers are forests.

No forest is flower.

**Conclusions**:

I. No houses is flower.

II. No flower is houses.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The possible venn diagram for the above statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c19ad1fc3a78949066c6ecf1351fc06d30deddb98b1459e1e04a51942fef20d.png] 

For Conclusions:

I. No houses is flower → True (All houses are rivers, all rivers are forests and no forests is flower is given. Therefore, no house is flower)

II. No flower is houses → (All houses are rivers, all rivers are forests and no forests is flower is given. Therefore, no flower is houses)

Hence, **Both conclusions I and II follow **is correct.

Mona, Kanak, John, Honey, Isha and Lara are watching a movie in a theater which has screen in the north. They are sitting in certain way.

(i) Only Kanak is sitting between Honey and John.

(ii) Lara is to the immediate right of Mona who is sitting at extreme left end.

(iii) Isha is to the immediate right of John.

Who is sitting at extreme right end?
questions.solution:
From the statements:

Lara is to the immediate right of Mona who is sitting at extreme left end.

Isha is to the immediate right of John.

Only Kanak is sitting between Honey and John. (This means, Kanak will sit to the immediate left of John and honey will sit to the immediate left of Kanak)

Thus, the final arrangement will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ca020aaafe2a452b6e1b2f62e551ea1f7e9fb72915386db9a68cfbf0d9c06c4.png] 

We can see that Isha is sitting at the extreme right end.

Hence, **Isha **is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69015e9c00cfe6a323b926a26458e9be0223665166c8e81cd6906b3a7bc04c77.png] 

**"Who"** is used for the **second person** in a sentence.

For example, 

Lara is to the right of** Mona, who** is sitting at extreme left → It means Lara is to the right of Mona and ***Mona is sitting at extreme left end.***

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circle facing towards the center. D is third to the left of A who is Second to the left of F. E is not a neighbor of either F or D. C is third to left of B. What is G’s position with respect to C?
questions.solution:
From the statements:

D is third to the left of A who is Second to the left of F.

E is not a neighbor of either F or D. (This means, E sits to the immediate left of A)

C is third to left of B. (This means, B and C will sit to the immediate left of F and E respectively)

Now, the remaining position i.e. to the immediate left of D will be occupied by G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09d59ee02ffb89eb37fc8b308e73e8c6bdd03f25d1ab36725818b6c3a4933bc1.png] 

We can see that G sits second to the left of C.

Hence, **second to the left **is correct.

questions.question: Anil is taller than Sunny who is shorter than Baby. Anil is taller than Bose who is shorter than Sunny. Baby is shorter than Anil. Who is the shortest ?
questions.solution:
**From the statements:**

⇒ Baby is shorter than Anil.

Anil > Baby

⇒ Anil is taller than Sunny who is shorter than Baby.

Anil > Baby > Sunny

⇒ Anil is taller than Bose who is shorter than Sunny.

Thus, the final arrangement is as follows:

Anil > Baby > Sunny > Bose

We can see that Bose is the shortest.

Hence, **Bose** is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7500cd7311daefd5e9fc9e1a87399ef581468354b683fce9430592642bd18bd2.png] 

**Who **is used for the **second person** in a connecting statement:

For example: 

Anil is taller than __**Sunny, who**__ is shorter than Baby → It means Anil is taller than Sunny and ***Sunny is shorter than Baby***.

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements**:

Some beds are chairs.

All chairs are desks.

All desks are tables.

**Conclusions**:

I. Some tables are beds.

II. Some desks are beds.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both Conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348f982b0f11da79622a28648c7ff0060dd4610e466d7b8200b60c592ba2a0d8.png] 

Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

The possible venn diagram is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6214833edcfc0d79fab6166399033888d71b84c6876d4c9532d87d629fcc331a.png] 

For conclusions:

I. Some tables are beds → True (Some beds are chairs, all chairs are desks and all desks are tables. Therefore, some tables are beds)

II. Some desks are beds → True (Some beds are chairs, all chairs are desks and all desks are tables. Therefore, some desks are beds)

Hence, **Both conclusions I and II follow** is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__
